reflections.title: Standing Together Against Evil

reflect.text: When the tribes of Israel heard about the terrible crime done in Gibeah, they acted quickly. People came together from across the land, completely united in mind and purpose. They set aside everything else so they could deal with this wrong and remove the wickedness from their midst. As F. B. Meyer notes, this kind of promptness and united seriousness against sin is something God's people must take to heart.

God calls his people to value holiness. While we live in a broken world and must interact with all kinds of people in daily life, we still need to guard our hearts. We may work and do business alongside anyone, but Meyer warns us against making close companions of those who ignore God's truth. If we let worldly ways into our closest circle of fellowship, we risk taking on "the color of the ground on which you lie" and losing our loyalty to the Lord.

questions: Are there close friendships or influences in your life that are quietly pulling you away from God?
How can you encourage your church family to stay united in seeking what is pure and right?
reflections.prayer: Lord, help us to stand together in love for what is good and true. Protect our hearts from harmful influences that would draw us away from you. Give us wisdom in our relationships so that we honor you in both our work and our friendships. Amen.
